summary: First iteration test run for ConTech OS landing. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests pass (100%) covering POST /api/waitlist happy path, 422 validation (invalid email, empty name, missing name), case-insensitive duplicate detection, GET /api/waitlist/count, and count-increment persistence. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): hero screen renders globe-3d, header-logo, scroll-hint correctly; mouse-wheel scrolling triggers scroll-driven animations and reveals header-join-button + header-menu-button; menu-overlay opens with all four menu-link-what/connect/works/join entries; hero-join-waitlist-button opens waitlist-sheet; empty-name validation shows 'Please enter your name.' and bad-email shows 'Please enter a valid email.'; valid submission with investor chip produces waitlist-success with correct title 'You're on the list' and waitlist-success-position '#6 in line'; Done button closes sheet; connect section audience-node-tech/-investors update audience-detail-title to 'Technology providers'/'Investors'; works section dual-card-offer-tab/-demand-tab are tappable and dual-card flips on tap; final section waitlist-count-text shows '6 professionals have already joined'; final-join-waitlist-button opens the sheet. No deprecated expo packages detected (expo-gl + three used for the globe; no expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch).

ui_bugs.issue: After tapping waitlist-close-button on a fresh (non-success) sheet, waitlist-sheet was still DOM-visible 500ms later. Could be the 300ms Modal fade animation (animationType='fade') not yet finished, or an actual close-handler miss. Done-button close worked fine. Needs quick manual re-check.

issues: Minor: console warns 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (comes from react-native-web usage in Header and index.tsx). Non-blocking but should migrate to style.pointerEvents to be future-proof.

action_items: Verify waitlist-close-button reliably dismisses the sheet (likely just the 300ms fade; add testing wait or confirm handler). Low priority.

Replace deprecated prop `pointerEvents=` with `style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}` in Header's bar Animated.View, logo Animated.View, right Animated.View, and the root <View> of index.tsx to silence RN-Web warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB `_id` via WaitlistOut Pydantic model (id is returned as str) — good.
Unique index on `email` is created at startup and duplicate handling returns the original record — correct and idempotent.
Email is lowercased+stripped before insert and lookup, ensuring case-insensitive dedup — verified by test.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL via api.ts (not hardcoded) — good.
All interactive elements have testID coverage used in this test run.
Minor: In index.tsx, `pointerEvents` is passed as a prop on <View> and <Animated.View>; react-native-web prints a deprecation warning. Migrate to style.pointerEvents.
File sizes are all well under 700 lines; no DRY violations observed in the surveyed components.
seed_data_creation: Created a handful of TEST_* and ui_* waitlist entries in MongoDB during pytest + Playwright runs. Final count observed in UI: 6. These do not conflict with the existing test@example.com entry.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use mouse-wheel to scroll inside the landing page — DOM scrollTo on [data-testid='landing-scroll'] does NOT fire the Reanimated onScroll handler, so header reveal and section opacity won't trigger. For modal dismissals via waitlist-close-button, wait >= 700ms after click for the fade animation to complete before asserting visibility.
rca_of_issue: No critical bug. Only observation: `pointerEvents` prop deprecation warning (react-native-web). Fix: move prop to style ({ pointerEvents: 'auto' | 'none' | 'box-none' }).
